science.qualification: Shared neutral gray display convention for a planet with no image or measured color in this package; a sphere of the published radius, lit by its own star, whose measured color (#ffcd6a, the color dataset of trappist-1 (src/objects/trappist-1/source/photometry/stellar-color.json)) tints the gray at the same brightness.
